desc: 深黛蓝场加胡桃亚麻台面的低暖掠射光宽口径奶瓶，七屏留白式详情
leaf: 宽口径蛋形罩盖磨砂瓶身奶瓶
name: 玄蓝铜环宽口径罩盖奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用深黛蓝场与胡桃亚麻台面把蛋形透明罩盖、宽瓶盖环与磨砂瓶身一次交代清楚，靠暗场反差在浅色详情页流里抢首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一留白带放一条中文主标（暖骨白字）与一行小字副标，主标前一枚铜环圆点标记，其下一条铜细横线

shots.intent: 把源图的恐吓式痛点正文与三块灰色占位卡改成三行留白疑问条，条目全部交给占位符，既有痛点版式又不写任何医疗、月龄与材质断言
shots.textZone: 每条右半一行小标题与一枚空白胶囊，左半为空白图位，条目名全部占位不写正文

shots.intent: 复刻源图的四图标卡与竖排三图标列，把重复的通用图标与重复条目名换成四枚统一尺寸的铜环圆点标记与空白标签，结构清楚又不编造事实
shots.textZone: 卡内顶部一行标题与一条铜细横线，其下四枚铜环圆点各带一条空白标签胶囊，底部一条空白细线带

shots.intent: 以仰视微距交代罩盖、宽瓶盖环与环下烟灰肩带的真实装配关系，两条空白引线承接结构条目，撑起做工质感信任
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签胶囊、右侧一枚空白标签胶囊，条目文字全部占位，不写部件名

shots.intent: 把源图「在家用」的文字诉求落成真实居家语境，成人从肩下取景、婴儿只留背影且全程被托抱，让买家代入又不越界
复刻详情页产品信息两栏档案，把品牌、容量、材质等全部字段改为空白填写位并配一支正侧面裁切瓶体，杜绝参数与材质杜撰
shots.textZone: 卡顶一行档案标题带铜环圆点与铜细横线，其下五行空白档案条目，字段名与数值全部占位

shots.intent: 把源图末尾的选款表与会员二维码换成两支既有色差只有的并置选款屏，色条留空白胶囊，收口同时完成选款引导
shots.textZone: 下部留白带放一行选款小标题、两支下方各一枚空白标签胶囊与一枚只带短字的空白行动按钮

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous dark interior: a deep navy #1B2A44 flat backdrop wall with a soft vertical light falloff, meeting a dark walnut #33211A plank tabletop with an open close grain, dressed with a loosely laid sand linen #C6AE86 runner whose folds catch the raking light; infographic screens are sand #DCC59E cards and panels floating on that same navy field, every screen edged by one thin copper #C1854B hairline frame; never a limewash plaster arch, never stacked plaster steps or block tiers, never a glass-and-water studio, never a micro-cement slab, never a fabric or rattan basket, never a podium disc, sphere cluster or gradient card, never a white or pale pastel studio ground
style.direction: deep navy and sand copper-ringed maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: every marker drawn as one thin copper #C1854B circle outline about one line-weight thick with one small solid copper dot sitting at its exact centre, at one identical diameter across the whole set, the ring holding no glyph and no letter inside it; callout leaders are one thin copper rule ending in the same ring-and-dot marker placed directly on the referenced part, followed by one plain rounded outline label pill left visually empty; never a squircle chip, never a dotted or dashed circle, never a filled disc stamp, never a triangular flag, pennant or ribbon, never a square tick, never a numeral inside a ring and never a second line weight or second ring size
style.lightingSystem: low warm raking key at about 4000K entering from camera left close to tabletop height so it skims across the linen weave, the walnut grain and the frosted body, balanced by a warm copper-toned bounce card low at camera right lifting only the shadow side; one long soft shadow pools to camera right, one true warm contact shadow sits under the rounded base, the clear dome keeps a single clean specular streak along its left flank rather than an all-over gloss, contrast medium with a deep falloff into the navy, never a cool cast, never a frontal overhead wash and no mirror reflection on the wood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent deep-navy, sand and copper maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy backdrop field #1B2A44, sand card ground #DCC59E and sand linen runner #C6AE86 over a dark walnut #33211A tabletop, one copper accent #C1854B, warm bone text #F0E4CE on navy and deep espresso text #2B1C12 on sand; warm tone at about 4000K throughout, never a cool cast; background system limited to that deep navy backdrop with a soft vertical falloff meeting the walnut tabletop dressed with the sand linen runner, infographic screens as sand cards floating on the same navy field, every screen edged with one thin copper hairline frame, never a limewash plaster arch, never stacked plaster steps or block tiers, never a glass-and-water studio, never a micro-cement slab, never a fabric or rattan basket, never a podium disc, sphere cluster, gradient card or pale studio ground; a low warm raking key at about 4000K entering from camera left close to tabletop height, skimming the weave and the grain, a warm copper-toned bounce low at camera right, one long soft shadow pooling to camera right, one true warm contact shadow under the base, one clean specular streak along the left flank of the clear dome, medium contrast with deep falloff into the navy and no mirror reflection on the wood; dark walnut planks with an open matte grain under a slubby sand linen runner with natural creases, the bottle settling into the cloth with real weight, no gloss floor and no wet surface; one modern geometric sans family throughout with a short Chinese headline in warm bone on navy and espresso on sand, each headline fronted by one small copper ring-and-dot marker and followed by one thin copper hairline rule, no serif face, no serif numeral, no Latin kicker or overprint, no highlighter band, no filled square bullet and no dot-pagination marker; every icon or index marker drawn as one thin copper circle outline with one small solid copper dot at its exact centre at one identical diameter and no glyph inside the ring, callout leaders drawn as one thin copper rule ending in the same ring-and-dot marker on the part and one plain empty rounded outline pill, never a squircle chip, never a dotted or dashed circle, never a filled disc stamp, never a triangular flag, never a square tick and never a numeral in a ring; the bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the tall clear egg-shaped dome fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the teat fully seated inside the dome, bell-shaped frosted milk-white body with soft waist taper, smoky grey-brown translucent shoulder band under the collar ring, pale tip button at the dome apex, original dome height, collar flare and rounded base, only the two reference collar colourways of rose-pink and powder-blue with no recolouring, any graduation marking kept exactly as shot and never added, any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cool key, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical or functional-benefit wording of any kind: no 「防胀气」, no 「不胀气」, no 「防呛」, no anti-colic, choking, air-intake, relief, cure, digestion or comfort-phrasing, and no mechanism caption that implies a health result
no breastfeeding-equivalence, parenting-emotion or development claim: no 「延续母乳」, no 「仿母乳」, no 「健康成长」, no 「提升宝宝抓握能力」 and no grip, habit or learning benefit wording
no age indication: no 「新生儿」, no 「婴儿专用」, no 「适合各个年龄」, no month or year range and no suitability statement about a child
no material or safety grade claim: no PPSU, PES, PC, PP, 玻璃, 高硼硅, 硅胶, 食品级, food-grade, BPA-free, 「安全材质」 or 「不含双酚A」 wording, and no surface-performance claim such as 「高清漆」, 「耐摔耐磨」, 「硬度高」 or 「防爆」
no thermal or structural performance claim: no 「双层真空」, no 「聚热锁温」, no 「保温」, no vacuum-layer assertion, no Celsius or Fahrenheit figure and no cycle count
no sterilisation, disinfection, antibacterial or hygiene standard, no sterilisation rate, no pathogen name and no 「可消毒」 wording
no import or origin claim: no 「进口」, no country name, no flag artwork, no heritage, factory, 厂家 or supplier wording
no certification, award, medal, rosette, star, inspection seal, test report, registration or filing number, execution-standard code, and no comparison bar, percentage or multiple of any kind

no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres, no dimension in millimetres or centimetres, no pack count, piece count, shelf life, date, price, discount, coupon, countdown or delivery-time figure
no brand name, store name, platform sticker, material-site watermark such as 「大卫先生素材」, 「加入会员」 or 「全店免费」 membership corner or QR code

no feeding-infant face and no adult face: any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, always held and supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down, the bottle held by the adult, never at a child's mouth and never left unattended

no loose, detached, unsecured or floating nipple, no exploded parts and no handle, brush, valve or accessory added to the product; no microwave, no steam and no hot liquid or water touching skin anywhere in the set

no palette or scene drift: no white, cream, pastel, mint, lilac, coral or aqua studio ground, no cool bluish key, no limewash plaster arch, no stacked plaster steps, no glass-and-water studio, no micro-cement slab, no fabric or rattan basket, no podium disc or sphere cluster, no squircle chip, no dotted circle, no triangular flag, no square tick, no serif numeral, no mixed fonts, no inconsistent lighting and no mismatched icon style between screens
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the tall clear egg-shaped dome fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the teat fully seated inside the dome; the bell-shaped frosted milk-white body with its soft waist taper, the smoky grey-brown translucent shoulder band directly under the collar ring, the pale tip button visible at the dome apex, the ribbed teat and the small inner vent disc visible through the dome, the original dome height, collar flare and rounded base are never redrawn; the reference set shows exactly two collar-ring colourways, rose-pink and powder-blue, and no third colour may be invented or recoloured; any graduation or scale marking visible in the reference stays exactly as shot and is never added or removed, the reference bodies show none so none is drawn; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product never floats, always keeps its warm contact shadow, vertical lines stay strictly vertical, one real object anchors scale inside every scene shot and the product is never occluded by props
style.surfaceSystem: dark walnut #33211A plank tabletop with an open matte grain and visible butt joint, partly covered by a slubby sand linen #C6AE86 runner with natural creases; the frosted bottle settles into the cloth with real weight and soft fabric shading at its base, the wood reads as wood and the cloth as woven cloth, no gloss floor, no wet surface and no reflection
style.typography: one modern geometric sans family throughout, light-to-medium weight, generous leading; one short Chinese headline in warm bone #F0E4CE on the navy fields and in deep espresso #2B1C12 on the sand cards, each headline fronted by one small copper ring-and-dot marker and followed by one thin copper hairline rule; one short sub-line of copy only; no serif face, no serif numeral, no Latin kicker or overprint word, no highlighter band, no filled square bullet, no dot-pagination marker, no mixed fonts and no dense body text
